title: Penelope Weeps (the Cretan tale)
part: Energy re-shoots (odyssey/writers-room/BIBLE.md section 6): a caption that promises an action the picture does not show
hypothesis: 'Penelope weeps as if melting snow' reads if her weeping is a body turned into its grief, the hand at the bowed head, and is held on long enough to be seen; in take 1 the WEEP put her right hand up beside her head (arm pitch -1.85, nothing turned), which from the front reads as a wave, and the shot under the line was 4.3 s of Odysseus's still close.
variable: Penelope's weeping: the WEEP pose (arm -1.85 -> -1.25 so the hand comes to the temple, the head bowed further, the body and head turned into the hand: WEEP params.twist, a new parameter), laid on the published sheet as the difference it makes (layer 'take2', from two compiles of today's engine with and without the change); and its share of the line: shot 7 split, her weeping 28.5-30.83 s, then his hard eyes 30.83-32.8 s (was 4.3 s on him).
held: the voice cut and the captions
Odysseus's performance and every other drawing of Penelope's (the delta is zero outside 22.25-35.4 s)
shots 0-5 and 10-13 carried frame for frame from take 1 (frames 0-266 and 428-613); frames 267-427 (22.25-35.58 s) drawn new with today's solver

result: Not kept (an honest failure). By the audit's numbers the take is better (film still share 0.32 -> 0.28; the 4.3 s still close under the line is now 2.3 s of her and 2 s of him). On the contact sheet it is not: from the front, the cameras today's solver picks for her, the turned WEEP still reads as a hand raised beside her head (a wave or an oath), the head barely bowed, because a minifig's arm cannot cross the face and the legality layer keeps the hand out of the head; and the close at 32.8 s, which in take 1 was cut from her side where the hand covers the face and reads as weeping, was re-solved from the front. The weeping is a pose and angle problem: a next take should hold take 1's side angle for every shot of her and bow the head into the hand there (WEEP params.twist is in tools/perform/intents-more.js for it). The sheet, the plan and the scene module are back as take 1 has them.
